SELECT ANY_VALUE(a.shop_id) as shop_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_id) as product_id, b.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_name) as product_name, ANY_VALUE(a.product_text) as text, ANY_VALUE(a.shelve_state) as shelve_state, ANY_VALUE(a.if_huabei) as if_huabei, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as original_price, ANY_VALUE(c.shop_name) as shop_name, ANY_VALUE(c.shop_logo) as shop_logo, ANY_VALUE(a.product_brief) as product_brief, ANY_VALUE(a.classify_id) as classify_id, ANY_VALUE(a.if_logistics) as if_logistics, ANY_VALUE( ifnull(g.users, 0) + a.fictitious_number) as users, ANY_VALUE( ifnull(x.number, 0) + y.fictitious_number) as number, ANY_VALUE(0) as activityType, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(b.weight) as weight from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop c ON a.shop_id = c.shop_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(a.buyer_user_id) users,a.product_id FROM ( SELECT b.buyer_user_id,a.product_id FROM cere_order_product a,cere_shop_order b where a.order_id=b.order_id and b.state IN(2,3,4) GROUP BY a.product_id,b.buyer_user_id ) a GROUP BY a.product_id ) g ON a.product_id=g.product_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(a.number) number, b.shop_id from cere_order_product a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON a.order_id = b.order_id where b.shop_id = #{shopId} and b.state IN(2,3,4) ) x ON a.shop_id = x.shop_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(a.fictitious_number) fictitious_number from cere_shop_product a where a.shop_id = #{shopId} ) y on 1 = 1
where b.sku_id = #{skuId} GROUP BY b.sku_id
SELECT product_image from cere_product_image where product_id=#{productId}
SELECT a.image from cere_sku_name a LEFT JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.sku_id=b.sku_id where b.product_id=#{productId} and a.image IS NOT NULL and a.image != ''

SELECT ANY_VALUE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.classify_level_hierarchy, '/', -1), '/', 1)) from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN cere_product_classify b ON a.classify_id = b.classify_id where a.shop_id = #{shopId} GROUP BY replace(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.classify_level_hierarchy, '/', 2), '/', '')
SELECT SUM(a.number) from cere_order_product a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON a.order_id=b.order_id where a.sku_id=#{skuId} and b.state IN(2,3,4)

SELECT a.shop_id, d.shop_name, a.product_id, a.product_name, a.product_brief, c.product_image image, b.sku_id, b.original_price, b.price, 0 as activityType, ifnull(f.number, 0) + a.fictitious_number as number from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(a.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as original_price from cere_product_sku a,cere_shop_product b where a.product_id=b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id ) b ON a.product_id=b.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a,cere_shop_product b where a.product_id=b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id ) c ON a.product_id=c.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop d ON a.shop_id=d.shop_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(number) number, sku_id, ANY_VALUE(order_id) as order_id from cere_order_product GROUP BY sku_id ) f ON b.sku_id=f.sku_id where a.shelve_state=1 and d.state=1
and a.product_name like concat('%', #{search}, '%')
and b.price >= #{minMoney} and b.price <= #{maxMoney}
and a.product_id in
#{productId}
ORDER BY
price,
price DESC,
ifnull(f.number, 0) + a.fictitious_number,
ifnull(f.number, 0) + a.fictitious_number DESC,
a.update_time DESC,a.create_time DESC

SELECT ANY_VALUE(a.product_id) as product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(a.weight) as weight, ANY_VALUE(a.SKU) as SKU, ANY_VALUE(d.product_name) as product_name, GROUP_CONCAT(b.sku_value) value,ANY_VALUE(c.product_image) as image from cere_product_sku a LEFT JOIN cere_sku_name b ON a.sku_id=b.sku_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a,cere_shop_product b where a.product_id=b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id ) c ON a.product_id= c.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_shop_product d ON a.product_id=d.product_id where a.sku_id=#{skuId}
SELECT classify_id id,classify_pid parentId,classify_name categoryName,classify_level depth,classify_image FROM cere_product_classify where classify_level=1
SELECT classify_id id,classify_pid parentId,classify_name categoryName,classify_level depth,classify_image FROM cere_product_classify where classify_level!= 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.shop_id, d.shop_name, d.shop_logo, a.product_id, a.product_name, c.product_image image, b.sku_id, b.original_price, b.price, 0 as activityType, (ifnull(sku.product_sales_volume,0) + ifnull(a.fictitious_number,0)) as number, ifnull(sku.sales_user_count,0) as users from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(a.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as original_price from cere_product_sku a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON a.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop d ON a.shop_id = d.shop_id LEFT JOIN cere_product_classify e ON a.classify_id = e.classify_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(number) number, sku_id, ANY_VALUE(order_id) as order_id from cere_order_product GROUP BY sku_id) f ON b.sku_id = f.sku_id LEFT JOIN cere_sku_member_real_info sku ON sku.sku_id = b.sku_id where a.shelve_state = 1 and sku.member_level_id = 0 and d.state = 1 and sku.product_sales_volume > 0 ORDER BY sku.product_sales_volume DESC) a ORDER BY RAND()

SELECT a.shop_id, d.shop_name, a.product_id, a.product_name, c.product_image image, b.price, b.sku_id, b.original_price, a.product_brief from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(a.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as original_price from cere_product_sku a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON a.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop d ON a.shop_id = d.shop_id where d.state = 1 and a.shelve_state = 1 and a.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY a.update_time DESC LIMIT 4

select a.product_id, a.shop_id, a.product_text as text, a.shelve_state, a.if_huabei, a.product_brief, a.classify_id, a.if_logistics, b.sku_id, b.weight, b.price, b.original_price c.shop_name, c.shop_logo from cere_shop_product a join cere_product_sku b on b.product_id = a.product_id join cere_platform_shop c on a.shop_id = c.shop_id where b.sku_id = #{skuId}
